name: I Love LA
description: A codependent friend group navigates life and love in Los Angeles. With aspirations of becoming a talent manager, Maia is stalled out as an assistant while living with her boyfriend...until her longtime best friend and frenzied influencer Tallulah returns.

videos.title: Block Her
videos.overview: On her 27th birthday, Maia deals with the sudden return of her best friend Tallulah.

videos.title: Roger & Munchy
videos.overview: After reconciling, Maia and Tallulah step into their new roles as manager and client while tackling an increasingly erratic situation.

videos.title: Girl's Girl
videos.overview: After a viral rant, Tallulah struggles with online hate, while Maia wrestles with following her managerial instincts.

videos.title: Upstairses
videos.overview: At a party, Maia and Alani have a once-in-a-lifetime encounter, Tallulah gets roped into making content, and Charlie meets someone new.

videos.title: They Can't All Be Jeremys
videos.overview: Impressed with Maia's strides at work, Alyssa invites her and Dylan over for dinner. Meanwhile, Charlie finds himself charmed by Lukas and his friend group, and Alani teaches Tallulah to drive.

videos.title: Game Night
videos.overview: Maia scores Tallulah a high-profile ad campaign, but Tallulah questions its resulting impact on her brand. Maia joins Dylan’s work friends for a game night, and things get horny. Meanwhile, Charlie runs into an ex at a funeral.

videos.title: Divas Down
videos.overview: While Tallulah is completely absorbed in her new relationship, Maia turns her attention to scoring a seat for Tallulah at an exclusive fashion dinner. Alani accompanies Charlie home from a surgery.

videos.title: I Love NY
videos.overview: The girls return to New York for an exclusive fashion event, and Maia tries to enjoy herself while Tallulah contends with some questionable styling decisions. Alani plans a surprise for her parents' anniversary. Back in LA, Charlie checks on Dylan.
